name: Office Workflow
description: Evidence-first planning instructions for desktop Office work through the approval broker.

skills.name: Evidence-first report
skills.description: Research, structure, and request approval before creating a local Office artifact.
skills.instructions: For document, spreadsheet, or presentation requests: identify the requested deliverable, gather only declared evidence with read tools, summarize the proposed structure, then call action_propose with the matching office_create action. Never claim the file exists until the approval receipt reports executed.
